$comment: Where each fact the website shows comes from. Precedence: HubSpot (decision 2026-09-15), then the Operations sheet, then the requester. Campus roles come from the Admissions Hub.

communityApp.registry: deployed Community app program registry (programs and program_summary)
communityApp.authorityBoundary: Community is authoritative only for Community ids, slugs, visibility, and Community-specific behavior. HubSpot remains authoritative for campus facts and business lifecycle.
communityApp.publicFactRestriction: Counts, deposits, staff relationships, and other operational data are not approved website facts without an explicit source decision.
communityApp.urlContract: https://www.community.alpha.school/?campus=<community-slug>; invite and ref are recognized referral parameters; preferred_campus is legacy and absent from the current deployed bundle.
communityApp.crosswalk: registry/campus-identities.json, joined to the growth map by exact HubSpot program id
communityApp.access: read-only inspection of the deployed app; do not store publishable keys or authentication data

hubspotPrograms.object: HubSpot custom object Programs (p_programs, objectTypeId 2-43470849), portal 40051392
hubspotPrograms.copyField: website_campus_intro (the intro block on the page; hand-typed today)

readPaths.direct: GET https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/2-43470849/{id}?properties=type,website_campus_intro,... with a token that has the scopes (ask Hailey McSpadden or a HubSpot admin: Dmitry Bakaev, Farhan Raja, Fernando Pina dos Santos)
readPaths.publicMirror: growth map API for type, name, address, city, state, url, communityUrl, coordinates, gradeRange, launchDate, photoUrl
readPaths.apexMirror: APEX imports Programs every 30 minutes (cron campus-hubspot-sync into CampusMapping and CampusPacketProfile.hubspotSnapshot); not exposed on the v1 API yet
readPaths.n8n: sub-workflow 6HvmvgkzPkFikc40 reads Programs and marketing events for the campus-page workflow

hubspotPrograms.writePath: APEX campus Program editor (human approval; HUBSPOT_PROGRAM_WRITE_TOKEN); never direct
hubspotPrograms.note: Agents read HubSpot live when they can; the field map tells them which property to read. A cached value is never the basis for a ticket without the read timestamp.

operationsSheet.name: Alpha & Specialty Schools National Growth Map
operationsSheet.access: Google Sheets API via the observer service account

staffRoster.status: Per-campus Meet the Guides SY26-27 decks registered 2026-09-21 in registry/staff-source-decks.json (name, public title, bio, photo per slide). Reviewable source for photos and the planned roster diff; the requester ticket still decides what changes. DoA and DoP come from campusRoles.
staffRoster.readPath: public pptx export of the deck (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<id>/export/pptx) until a Slides API reader exists

approvedMedia.owner: Yash Chitneni produces Open and Enrolling cards from one template

brandRules.file: marketingsupport docs/rules/alpha-brand-copy-rules.md and scripts/lib/alpha-brand-rules.mjs; skill repo trilogy-group/alpha-branding-skill
brandRules.precedence: MacKenzie's recorded choices over all other guidance

hubspotEvents.rule: Public Event = Yes must appear on /upcoming-events/ and the campus strip after a 2 hour grace

campusRoles.sourceOfTruth: Admissions Hub org chart, https://alpha-admissions-hub.vercel.app/admissions-hub.html (tables currentDoARows, approvedAssignmentRows, expansionRows, marketingRows, admissionsRows embedded in the page script)
mirrors: APEX directory Campus DoA Roster (projects/alpha-event-task-management/src/lib/apex-directory-roster.ts in the marketing workspace) with rows Hailey confirmed ahead of the chart
campusRoles.refresh: live on every ticket that needs an approver; --write snapshot weekly or when Hailey posts a roster change

hubspotOwners.gives: name, work email, owner id, team membership (Marketing, DoPs, Admissions, Admin, Operations, Community Partnerships)
hubspotOwners.note: Emails are only ever taken from here, from APEX permission files, or from a person directly. Never derived from a name: nicknames and other surnames make derived addresses wrong.

apexRouting.gives: auto-assignees by request type (website: Yash, Matt; calendars: Zara Raheem; video_editing: Haven Mass, Nick Stich; marketing_collateral: Chris Davidson), coverage owners (photography: Gaby Guajardo; videography: Chris Mass, Alfred Gomez), HubSpot push and event-editor rights (Hailey McSpadden, Brittany Goodman, Garbhit Sharma, Dmitry Bakaev, Farhan Raja)
apexRouting.access: source checkout in the marketing workspace; the APEX API does not expose it yet

n8nHubspotSync.name: HubSpot Program to n8n to WordPress sync
evidence: Cristi GDM with Matt/Yash/Dmitry on HubSpot/n8n/WP
n8nHubspotSync.note: Synced campus facts must be corrected in HubSpot, not by hand-editing WordPress fields that n8n overwrites.

missingInfoRouting.note: Role-based Missing Info routing promoted from Marketing Ops draft; people resolved via people.json or live campus resolver.

contentPipelines.note: Every automated writer to alpha.school: n8n campus pages and Locations List, the HubSpot events plugin stack, the growth map API, HubSpot-hosted surfaces, registration platforms, Google Business Profile push, video and editorial imports, and the other authenticated Elementor write routes.

n8n.access: operators only (Cristi Constantin); no agent access

onboardingSheet.name: School onboarding - single file for all schools

tabs.Website Copy Fixed: CSS ID -> Value, applied to every campus page (content_title, content_body_1 to 3, attend_cta_button)
tabs.Website Copy Dynamic: one row per HubSpot Program ID with the same CSS ID columns
tabs.People Bio: A Email, B Name, C Photo, D Bio, E Personal Statement / Quote (read by the n8n staff-source reader for the APEX agent)
tabs.Schools info: campuses in columns, HubSpot Program IDs in row 3, staff-role references by email

onboardingSheet.access: n8n Google Sheets credential (Cristi); no agent access yet

infoPackets.profile: APEX CampusPacketProfile (status, approvedBy, pdfUrl, wordpressUrl, hubspotSnapshot); not on the v1 API yet

readPaths.hubspotProgramFieldsNotOnGrowthMap: n8n execution payload of workflow ORgdHC71YJ5RawBy (GET /api/v1/executions?workflowId=...&limit=1, then /executions/{id}?includeData=true, about 65 MB) carries every Program property the nightly run read, including website_campus_intro, tuition, phone, email; use it when the HubSpot token lacks crm.objects.custom.read and the growth map omits the field
